chunks: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven skies and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?"
ai.seo_question: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Mighty Throne according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Tawhid al-Rububiyyah (Divine Lordship), affirming Allah’s absolute sovereignty over the seven heavens and the Great Throne (Al-Arsh al-Azim), which symbolizes the pinnacle of creation and divine authority. It serves as a foundational proof for God’s transcendence and direct governance, often referenced in discussions on the hierarchy of the cosmos and the attributes of the Divine.
